PRADESHIYA SABHA ACT, No. 15 OF 1987
Order

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, by Paragraph (d) of Section 9A of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987, I,Faiszer Musthapha, Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, do by this Order dissolve ThamankaduwaPreadeshiya Sabha constituted by an order published in the Extraordinary Gazette No. 453/24 dated 11th May 1987 witheffect from 30th June 2017 for the purpose of constitution of Polonnaruwa Municipal Council and Polonnaruwa PradeshiyaSabha.
FAISZER MUSTHAPHA,Minister of Provincial Councils andLocal Government.
Colombo,17th December 2016,
MUNICIPAL COUNCILS ORDINANCE
Order

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, by Sections 2, 3, 5 and 9 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance and subsection (3) ofSection 27F of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, I, Faiszer Musthapha, Minister of Provincial Councils andLocal Government, do by this Order–
(1) declare the area specified in Part -1 of the Schedule hereto, to be a Municipality for the purpose of thatOrdinance ;

(4) I, order that Polonnaruwa Municipal Council shall consist of -

PRADESHIYA SABHA ACT, No. 15 OF 1987
Order

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, by Section (1) of Section 2, Section 4 and Section 6 of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act,No. 15 of 1987 and Section 27F of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, I, Faiszer Musthapha, Minister of ProvincialCouncils and Local Government, do by this Order–
(1) declare the area specified in Part -1 of the Schedule hereto, to be a Pradeshiya Sabha area for the purpose ofthat Act ;
(2) define the administrative limits of the Pradeshiya Sabha area to be the limits as set out in Part - II of thatSchedule ;
(3) constitute a Pradeshiya Sabha for the Pradeshiya Sabha area declared under paragraph (1) of this Order andassign the following name to such Sabha ;
“Polonnaruwa Pradeshiya Sabha”
(4) I, order that Polonnaruwa Pradeshiya Sabha shall consist of -
(i) ten (10) members to be appointed under Paragraph (a) of the subsection (1) of Section (4) of the PradeshiyaSabha Act ;
(ii) three (03) members to be appointed under Paragraph (b) of section (4) of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act ;
(iii) four (04) female members to be elected under subsection (3) of Section 27F of Local Authorities ElectionsOrdinance.
(5) I, appoint 01.07.2017 as the date on which the term of office of the Polonnaruwa Pradeshiya Sabha shallcommence.
FAISZER MUSTHAPHA,Minister of Provincial Councils andLocal Government.
Colombo,17th December 2016,
